heading_en: Required Capital Ratio for the Portion in Excess of K_{IRB} (K_{SSFA}(K_{IRB}))
summary_ja: K_{IRB}超過部分の所要自己資本率(K_{SSFA}(K_{IRB}))の算式と、a、u、l及びパラメーターpの定義を定める。
summary_en: Gives the formula for the required capital ratio K_{SSFA}(K_{IRB}) for the portion above K_{IRB} and defines a, u, l, e, A, D and p.
paragraphs: The required capital ratio for the portion in excess of K_{IRB} ({{F:p237i4}}) provided in items (ii) and (iii) of the preceding Article means the value calculated by the following formula. {{F:p237i5}} a = −(1/(p*K_{IRB})) u = D − K_{IRB} l = max(A − K_{IRB}, 0) e, A, D and p are each as follows. e is the base of the natural logarithm (2.71828 shall be used). A is the attachment point (A). D is the detachment point (D). p is the parameter (p) calculated under the provisions of Article 235.
